This source-bound AMD64 qualification compares BASE1f33 and repaired b5933c08 benchmark harnesses using native runc and the same six immutable cached images. Twelve bounded controls cover nginx, HTTPD and all four Node concurrency leaves. With util's canonical tag removed, fixed harnesses must fail on the actual readiness error before emitting samples. No global Docker prune or daemon configuration mutation occurs.

Node's repaired StopTimer excludes reporting and deferred cleanup from its elapsed metric. Its historical timings are not comparable; every future runtime arm uses the same repaired harness. This qualifier makes no statistical claim and changes no Iperf metrics.
